summary: Speeches given at European Parliament plenary sessions by people speaking English as a second language, transcribed and segmented into utterances. One row is one such segment, scored against the normalised transcript. It combines non-native accents with unscripted institutional speech; no single region applies, so it carries the world-English tag rather than a country's. Runs on this corpus are capped at 2,000 clips, drawn with a pinned seed so every fighter is scored on the same ones; a split smaller than the cap is scored in full.
notes: VoxPopuli en_accented test split, non-native-accented English speech, a distinct config from the plain en test split; region tagged 001 (UN M.49 World) since no single accent region applies.
